entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element used by AMF to inform UE about S-NSSAIs rejected by the network due to authentication/authorization failure or revocation.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that includes the Rejected NSSAI IE in messages to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives the Rejected NSSAI information from the AMF.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Identifier that may be rejected by the network.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization failure or revocation
entities.description: Condition where S-NSSAI is rejected due to authentication/authorization issues as specified in subclause 4.6.2.4.

relations.description: AMF includes Rejected NSSAI IE to inform UE about rejected S-NSSAIs.
Rejected NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs that were rejected.
S-NSSAI rejection is guarded by authentication/authorization failure or revocation condition.
